cuts.name: The Tomahawk
cuts.description: A bone-in ribeye with the long bone left on, carved at your table. Deep, beefy and rich. This is the one to share.
cuts.imageAlt: A bone-in tomahawk steak resting on a wooden board with rosemary and coarse salt

cuts.name: Ribeye
cuts.description: The most marbled cut we serve. The fat melts into the meat over the charcoal and leaves a dark, savory crust.
cuts.imageAlt: A thick ribeye steak with a dark crust and melting butter

cuts.name: Fillet
cuts.description: Lean, tender and mild. We cut it thick so the middle stays juicy while the outside picks up the smoke.
cuts.imageAlt: A tall, round fillet steak on a dark plate

cuts.name: Sirloin
cuts.description: Firm, properly beefy, with a strip of fat along the edge that crisps on the grill. The one our regulars order most.
cuts.imageAlt: A sirloin steak with a crisp fat cap on a wooden board

cuts.name: T-Bone
cuts.description: A strip on one side of the bone and a fillet on the other. Two textures in one cut, for a big appetite.
cuts.imageAlt: A T-bone steak showing the strip and the fillet either side of the bone
